# OREENZA — Performance-first design & development studio

## Who we are
OREENZA is an independent design & development studio building performance-first brands, websites, products, and motion for ambitious teams. We are remote-first and work with clients worldwide.

## Services
OREENZA offers six core services:
- Brand Identity: Naming, logo systems, visual guidelines, brand voice
- Web Design: UX/UI, design systems, Next.js builds, CMS setup (Keystatic)
- Social Media Management: Content calendars, captions, community engagement, analytics
- GBP Management: Profile setup, weekly posts, review responses, local SEO
- App Development: iOS, Android, React Native, API integrations
- SEO With AI: AI keyword research, content optimization, technical SEO audits, rank tracking

## Work
OREENZA has shipped projects across industries including SaaS, retail, food & beverage, finance, architecture, travel, healthcare, and beauty. Case studies available at /project/[slug].

## Team
OREENZA is a small senior team of designers, engineers, and writers who ship for clients from cafés to SaaS companies.

## Contact

## Pages
- / : Homepage with selected works
- /services : Full service index with editorial magazine layout
- /services/[slug] : Individual service detail pages with long-form content
- /work : Project portfolio (redirects to /)
- /project/[slug] : Case study pages for each project
- /blog : Insights blog with articles on design, performance, and SEO
- /blog/[slug] : Individual blog posts
- /team : Team page
- /contact : Contact form, Calendly booking, WhatsApp QR, email, phone

## Technology
- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router)
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Keystatic CMS
- TypeScript throughout
- Performance-first: Lighthouse 95+ targets
- Deploys on Vercel or Fly.io

## Socials
Available at /contact and linked in the site footer.

## Availability
OREENZA takes on a limited number of projects per quarter. Contact to check current availability.
